name: address-changed-old
subject: The contact address of your Permaily account changed

blocks.text: The contact address of your Permaily account was changed to another one. This address is no longer the account's: messages about the account, and signing in by email, go to the new address from now on.
If it was you, there is nothing to do.
If it was not you, write to support@permaily.com from this address as soon as you can.
